summary: Aclarion, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing its board authorized a $2.5 million share repurchase program over the next 12 months. Repurchases may be made via open-market or private transactions, block trades, accelerated share repurchase, or 10b5-1 plans, under Rule 10b-18. No specific price, premium, or share count is set; the program is discretionary and can be suspended anytime. No advisors or board recommendations are named. As a capital return via buyback, the filing is a routine authorization without immediate contractual terms. The watch point is execution pace and any impact on floating supply or earnings per share.
